p: Hollins will return to practice this week as the team works him back in.
His return adds a veteran WR option, though his Week 9 role depends on how practice goes.
Mack and Gvr will return to play.
Will remain a significant part of the offense going forward.
Hollins has chemistry with Drake Maye, who looked his way in big moments last week, so he is worth rostering as a WR/flex consideration.
I would imagine that he'd be a big part of our success going forward.
